title: Dan PT website
summary: I designed Dan PT's logo and website while at hellooodesign, then built and launched the site. Dan was just starting out and had no website.
imageAlt: The Dan PT logo, the homepage on a laptop and a view of the full page

heroImage.alt: A laptop showing the Dan PT homepage, with the headline "1-to-1 Personal Training in Kent" beside a photo of Dan

headlineStart: Designing and building a website for a Kent

brief.heading: Dan needed his first website
brief.intro: He was just getting started, and these were the aims.

items.title: A place online
items.text: Somewhere to show his services, packages and reviews.

items.title: Local search
items.text: He wanted to rank well with clients nearby.

items.title: Ease of use
items.text: The site had to be simple for his clients.

items.title: Logo
items.text: A kettlebell mark beside the Dan PT name. The site uses the same orange.

items.title: Top of the homepage
items.text: It says what Dan offers and where, with buttons for pricing and his background.

items.title: Services
items.text: Cards for 1-to-1 training, running coaching and online training, each with a link to more detail.

items.title: Contact
items.text: A contact page, a WhatsApp button and a newsletter sign-up.

items.title: Local areas
items.text: Kent appears in the headings, and the footer lists places such as Ashford, Canterbury, Folkestone and Maidstone.

items.title: About Dan
items.text: Google reviews, his mission statement and photos of him.

launch.heading: Dan can maintain it himself
launch.text: I built the site on WordPress with Elementor and made custom templates to work with it, so Dan can look after the site without a developer. I also set up the hosting, connected the domain and launched it.

items.alt: The whole homepage, from the headline to the footer
